top_choice_rationale: P002 rests on a quantitative prediction of flat bands near the magic angle (Bistritzer and MacDonald, 2011) followed by an unexpected, widely reproduced experimental demonstration of correlated insulating and superconducting states (Jarillo-Herrero, 2018), now carried to other moire platforms. The citation honours flat-band-driven correlated phases, not a theory of the pairing mechanism, so the open mechanism is not a maturity defect. The exact allocation is imperfect because Yuan Cao and earlier moire theorists fall outside three names, and I rank P002 first with reduced confidence. P001 is a close second: the magic-wavelength lattice is a distinct conceptual step with a stable interpretation and clean two-name credit, and I would accept it without reluctance. Either award is preferable to no award.
